s1.desc: a bedroom with a big yellow bed and duck-shaped bedposts

spans.view: with soft pillows and a duck-shaped bedpost behind them

beats.text: Pax lies curled around the sleeping Polly with a flipper over her and lifts his head
Pax raises his head above Polly and gazes down at her with wide, adoring eyes while she sleeps
Pax closes his eyes and presses a kiss onto the top of Polly's head

spans.notes: compare f0/f27 and furniture fit: identity overlap 1.000, camera locked

spans.view: with a bedside lamp on each side of the bed

beats.text: Pax spoons Polly from behind under the blanket, nuzzling the back of her head
Pax smiles with his eyes closed and rolls over onto his other side, turning his back to Polly
Polly turns to face up with her eyes still closed and starts to rise slowly out from under the blanket
Polly floats upright above the bed, stiff and straight with her flippers stretched out and her eyes closed
Polly glides down behind Pax and drapes herself over him in a hug

spans.notes: compare f28/f102: bed, headboard and lamps overlap exactly. Polly's floating is drawn as character motion, with no glow or sparkle effect

spans.view: with a duck-shaped bedpost behind them

beats.text: Polly drapes herself over Pax from behind, her flipper settling around him
Pax blinks his eyes open in surprise under Polly's hug
Pax closes his eyes and nestles back into Polly's embrace
Pax lies snuggled under Polly with his eyes closed and his beak open in a small happy O
Pax closes his beak and rests peacefully with his eyes shut under Polly's hug

spans.notes: compare f103/f221: bedside table, bedpost and pillows overlap exactly (fit identity 1.000). Only Polly's flipper and the top of her head show over Pax, so she is partial
